keyword.en: what HBT8018-132S means on the catalogue

title.en: Machine does not replace what HBT8018 Prints the 132S Model Line lists
title.zh: 「机器」不能替换HBT8018怎样印出132S型号行列出的数字

description.en: HBT8018 Prints the 132S Model Line. 132 kW stays in the catalogue entry. Illustration: Machine.
description.zh: HBT8018怎样印出132S型号行。132 kW仍在目录格子里。插图来自「机器」。

h1.en: Machine does not replace what HBT8018 Prints the 132S Model Line lists
h1.zh: 「机器」不能替换HBT8018怎样印出132S型号行列出的数字

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the HBT8018 concrete pump in Xingtai as model HBT8018 / HBT8018-132S. Motor power on that page is 132 kW. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Machine.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把 HBT8018 混凝土泵的型号写成 HBT8018 / HBT8018-132S。理论输送量是 60 m³/h，不是 132，也不是 18。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Machine。

body.en: The figure is the one published at https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Machine: Machine. Hebei Pinjin Machinery lists the HBT8018 concrete pump in Xingtai as model HBT8018 / HBT8018-132S. Conveying distance is 150 m and delivery height is 450 m, written as two labels rather than one H / V pair. The model line includes 132S. Pipe diameter is 100 / 125 mm.
body.zh: 这张图是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Machine页上的Machine。河北品锦机械在邢台把 HBT8018 混凝土泵的型号写成 HBT8018 / HBT8018-132S。输送距离 150 m 和输送高度 450 m 是分开的标题。

body.en: Motor power on that page is 132 kW. The suffix is part of the shown model line. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not list a legend that decodes the letter S. None of those is the number 18.
body.zh: 理论输送量是 60 m³/h，不是 132，也不是 18。这不是电动80的 900 m / 300 m，尽管两页都标出 60 m³/h 和 40 MPa。

body.en: Theoretical output is 60 m³/h, not 132 and not 18. It does not replace the output entry. Do not invent a meaning for S beyond the characters on the page. Conveying distance 150 m and delivery height 450 m are separate labels.
body.zh: 输送距离 150 m，输送高度 450 m，写成两个标题，而不是一组水平/垂直。

body.en: Pumping pressure is 40 MPa. The motor power entry says 132 kW. Aggregate is 4 cm and below. This is not Electric 80's pair 900 m / 300 m, even though both pages list 60 m³/h and 40 MPa. Also on this row: 100 / 125 mm. Weight is 6500 kg. None of those.
body.zh: 河北品锦机械没有标出一份图例来解释字母 S。这一行还有这些已印出的片段：100 / 125 mm. Weight is 6500 kg. None of those。

question.en: On this row: What is the full model line?

answer.en: HBT8018 / HBT8018-132S. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Machine.
answer.zh: HBT8018 / HBT8018-132S。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Machine画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Is output 132 m³/h?

answer.en: No. Output is 60 m³/h. 132 kW is the motor. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Machine.
answer.zh: 不是。产量是 60 m³/h。132 kW 是电机。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Machine画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: What does the letter S mean?
question.zh: 字母 S 是什么意思？

answer.en: The catalogue does not define it. Quote the model line as shown. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Machine.
answer.zh: 目录没有定义它。按写出的型号行引用即可。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Machine画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Is the height 450 m or 150 m?
question.zh: 高度是 450 m 还是 150 m？

answer.en: Delivery height is 450 m. Conveying distance is 150 m. They are different labels. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Machine.
answer.zh: 输送高度是 450 m。输送距离是 150 m。它们是不同的标题。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Machine画面里印出的数字。
